incidents.title: Construction Industry Council: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 28 Nov 2026. A cyberattack on the Construction Industry Council’s mobile app accessed personal data of approximately 500,000 registered construction workers. The council confirmed unauthorized access to names, dates of birth, gender, telephone numbers and identity document numbers. Hong Kong.

incidents.title: Chainalysis: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 28 Nov 2026. Chainalysis confirmed that hackers stole credentials and live tokens for all its customers in a multifront cyberattack involving AI agents and an on-path data snatch. Stolen data includes names, usernames, password hashes, and active authentication tokens. New York City, United States.

incidents.victim: Thomas More University of Applied Sciences
incidents.title: Thomas More University of Applied Sciences: Claimed by Qilin, not confirmed
incidents.description: Qilin claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 28 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Qilin publicly claimed a cyberattack on Thomas More University of Applied Sciences on 28 November and threatened to release data. The university is located in Mechelen, Belgium. Mechelen, Belgium.

incidents.title: Konicom: Claimed by Pear, not confirmed
incidents.description: Pear claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 28 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Pear claimed responsibility on 28 November for a cyberattack against Konicom, Inc., a provider of computer services in the US. The group posted an extortion notice indicating that sensitive data would be leaked. United States.

incidents.title: Korea Post (Internet Post Office): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Korea Post's Internet Post Office said that a hacking attack using overseas IP addresses exposed the names, addresses and phone numbers of registered-mail customers. Analysis of a single day's data alone identified 113,855 affected customers. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: Nikkei: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. An unauthorized intrusion into the external service KARTE used by Nikkei Inc. exposed approximately 5.4 million personal records, including email addresses and phone numbers. Nikkei confirmed the breach, stated that credit‑card data were not involved and that no misuse of the information has been detected. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: pCloud Pass: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. pCloud confirmed a cyberattack on its pCloud Pass password manager exposing a small number of user email addresses and triggering new device connected alerts on 28 November. The intrusion was isolated to pCloud Pass and cloud storage was unaffected. Switzerland.

incidents.title: Pacific Blue Cross: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Pacific Blue Cross experienced a cyber incident that caused its website and contact centre to go offline, preventing members from accessing services. The company confirmed the incident in a notice on its website and is working with external specialists to investigate and restore systems. Burnaby, Canada.

incidents.title: GMOペパボ: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. GMO Pepabo disclosed that unauthorized access to its “Lollipop! Rental Server” service resulted in the leakage of 516,564 customer records, including names, birth dates and email addresses. The company confirmed the breach and has invalidated the exposed passwords and notified affected customers. Fukuoka, Japan.

incidents.victim: UK Department for Work and Pensions
incidents.title: UK Department for Work and Pensions: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The UK Department for Work and Pensions took some online services offline as a precaution after detecting a cyber incident on 27 November. Regular pension and benefit payments continued while British cybersecurity officials helped investigate. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Planet IC: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Planet IC, an IT service provider in Schwerin, suffered unauthorised access to its servers on the evening of 21 November, knocking out numerous client websites. Customer data of the energy supplier WEMAG was probably stolen. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: QVC Japan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. QVC Japan reported that unauthorized access to the marketing tool KARTE is believed to have affected 57,595 customer records. The Tokyo-based retailer disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: au Financial Service: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. au Financial Service reported that unauthorized access to contractor PLAID's KARTE leaked 36,416 customer records including au PAY Card data. The Tokyo-based financial service disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store reported that online-store information leaked, with more than 880,000 records in total. The Osaka-based retailer disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Osaka, Japan.

incidents.title: Minkabu: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Minkabu reported that unauthorized access may have leaked some customers' asset amounts. The Tokyo-based financial media company disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Monex Securities: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Monex Securities reported that identity-verification documents leaked for some customers, with the company offering ¥5,000 compensation. incidents.title: Bic Camera: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Bic Camera reported unauthorized access to some systems and a possible leak of delivery and corporate customer information. The Tokyo-based retail company disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: ZOZO: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. ZOZO reported that its ZOZOTOWN development environment and WEAR by ZOZO were affected, listed among incidents involving more than one million records disclosed on 27 November. The Chiba-based retail/e-commerce company disclosed the incident in late November 2026. Chiba, Japan.

incidents.title: TSI Holdings: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. TSI Holdings announced that approximately 4.53 million records were leaked across five of its sites on November 27, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: SMBC Trust Bank: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. SMBC Trust Bank announced a leak of app identification information and usage history affecting 1,823 records on November 27, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Hokkokubank announced on November 27 that 291 internal user IDs of 'Tochitsuka' were leaked. Kanazawa, Japan.

incidents.title: SMS: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. SMS Co. announced on November 27 that 191,039 + 197,985 + 95,480 records across its job sites were leaked. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Kanda University of International Studies: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Kanda University of International Studies announced on November 27 that data of 37 users or agents may have been leaked. Chiba, Japan.

incidents.title: Kimitsu City (Rukumi Photo): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Kimitsu City announced on November 27 that parents' names, emails, and children's birth dates may have been leaked. Chiba, Japan.

incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. AXA General Insurance announced on November 27 that approximately 494,000 records were exposed through roadside-assistance contractor Prestige. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: StudySmarter: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. StudySmarter disclosed a serious cyberattack in which email addresses and password hashes were stolen, with millions of users worldwide told to change their passwords. incidents.title: Mittwald: Confirmed cyberattack

incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Unauthorized third parties gained access to personal contact and master data such as names and addresses from the customer base. Germany.

Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Clayton: Confirmed data breach

Fenton Missouri is the location. United States.

incidents.title: Port Authority of Livorno: Confirmed cyberattack

The Port Authority of Livorno suffered an external intrusion on Sunday afternoon that locked up and crashed its IT infrastructure. Computers at Palazzo Rosciano and other operational offices were disconnected. Livorno, Italy.

incidents.title: Kinatico: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Kinatico Limited reported a cybersecurity breach impacting its Cited™ platform with personal data of 320 individuals compromised. The announcement was made on 27 November. Melbourne, Australia.

incidents.title: Dirección General de Casinos: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Dirección General de Casinos suspended some administrative operations and temporarily closed two venues as a precaution. Montevideo is the location. Montevideo, Uruguay.

incidents.title: Mitsui Shopping Park: Confirmed data breach

Mitsui Shopping Park disclosed that unauthorised access to its app resulted in approximately 3.12 million members' personal information, including names, addresses and phone numbers, leaking. The Department of Work and Pensions took all its online welfare and pension services offline after a cyber incident. The department confirmed the outage as a precaution and said benefit payments continue. United Kingdom.

incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A possible cyberattack targeting the U.S. Army's computer systems was reported by media outlets. The Pentagon stated that its systems are secure and did not confirm any breach. United States.

incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Revolut blocked cards after a security incident occurred at a payment provider it uses. London, United Kingdom.
